descriptions.text: Incorrect logic in _transfer function of token contract. Vulnerable code snippet: https://bscscan.com/address/0x94e06c77b02ade8341489ab9a23451f68c13ec1c#code#L475 https://bscscan.com/address/0x94e06c77b02ade8341489ab9a23451f68c13ec1c#code#L494 Cause Uniswap pair can be reduced without any swap, so attacker can do price manipulation. Once imbalance in the pair, attacker can call skim() to get profit.

On 24 May 2022, HackDao was exploited on BNB Chain due to a flaw in the token's transfer fee logic and pool accounting. The attacker used flashloans and manipulated the LP pools using the skim and extra fee mechanisms, draining approximately 200 BNB (worth $65,000) from HackDao liquidity pools. The root cause was a flawed interaction between the HackDao token contract's special extra fee logic for transfers to specific pools (particularly the HackDao,USDT pool) and the UniswapV2Pair skim function. This enabled the attacker to drain tokens from liquidity pools by exploiting differences between recorded and actual balances after fee deductions.
